title: Sunshine Coast Museum & Archives

services.name: Fishing for a Living
services.desc: A Way of LifeThe Sunshine Coast is a region bordered and nurtured by the sea. Naturally, boat building and fishing have always been a part of life to its coastal inhabitants. Before the 1930s, there were so many salmon in the waters of the Sunshine Coast that the average fisherman believed stocks could never run out.
